description: Validates marketing website route contracts against React routes, validated metadata content, postbuild, generated organizer-listing sources, active-market eligibility, and Firebase Hosting 404 behavior.

rules.title: Keep marketing website route contracts ahead of visual review
rules.instruction: Before changing public marketing routes, generated organizer route families, SEO metadata, static postbuild output, robots/sitemap behavior, review states, route Storybook evidence, or route-owned URL state, update design/website/routes.json when the public contract changes and pass node tool/run.mjs check marketing:website-routes plus node tool/run.mjs check web:react-architecture-boundaries when React route boundaries are touched. The route gate validates runtime/static metadata, rejects deployable organizer listings outside live active-market cities, and validates matching Storybook parameters.catchRoute declarations for Storybook-backed review states. Start component-first review only after the route contract is current.
